title: Compact pieces of a C¹ chart on which f∘ψ agrees with C¹ functions (C¹ approximation; parent Step 3)
lean_statement: (∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid m → ℝ) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K u → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ G : Euclid m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 G ∧ volume {y | u y ≠ G y} < ε) → ∀ (m P : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (C C' : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (F : ℕ → Euclid m → ℝ), (∀ k, IsCompact (C k) ∧ IsCompact (C' k) ∧ Convex ℝ (C' k) ∧ C k ⊆ interior (C' k) ∧ C' k ⊆ V ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (F k) ∧ ∀ y ∈ C k, f (ψ y) = F k y) ∧ volume (V \ ⋃ k, C k) = 0
